faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about my services, workflow and pricing.

q1.question: What types of services do you offer?
q1.answer: I design bespoke websites, landing pages and modern web applications for freelancers and SMEs. Every project is built from scratch using top-performing technologies (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS) to ensure speed, optimal SEO and a flawless user experience.

q2.question: How much does a website cost?
q2.answer: Every project is unique — it all depends on your needs, complexity and scope. I don't give blind price estimates: the cost is defined after a free initial call where we figure out together what you really need. You then receive a detailed, personalised quote with no commitment.

q3.question: What is the delivery timeline?
q3.answer: A standard showcase website is delivered within 2 to 4 weeks. A landing page can be ready in 1 to 2 weeks. These timelines include design, development, revisions and deployment phases. I commit to precise dates from the project kickoff.

q4.question: Do you offer maintenance services?
q4.answer: Yes. After delivery, I provide support for content updates, technical adjustments and ongoing performance optimization. Maintenance is optional and can be subscribed as a monthly package tailored to your needs.

q5.question: Will my site be optimized for Google?
q5.answer: Absolutely. Every site is built following SEO best practices: semantic HTML structure, optimized metadata, maximum performance (Core Web Vitals), perfect mobile compatibility and structured data. Your site is designed to be visible on Google and AI search engines.

q6.question: How does the collaboration work?
q6.answer: The process is straightforward: a free initial call to understand your needs, then a detailed proposal with mockups. After approval, I develop the site with regular checkpoints. You get revisions until full satisfaction before the final launch.

summary.label: Profile
summary.title: Antoine Ghigny
summary.content: Software Engineer specializing in the design, development and deployment of distributed systems and microservices architectures. Based in Nivelles, Belgium, I combine my backend engineering expertise with a passion for digital creation serving freelancers and SMEs.

accenture.details: Promoted to lead developer on the European Commission's CBAM project. Engineering and optimizing backend services for high-availability regulatory systems deployed on Kubernetes. Integrating Apache Kafka for event-driven architecture and managing container orchestration in production.

proximus.details: Full-stack developer on the Webshop platform. Developing and scaling reactive microservices in Node.js, designing features with Angular and integrating RESTful and GraphQL services in a distributed environment.
